namingPolicyNotHistory: Korean map labels are editorial conventions; they do not change local official names, historical officialPeriods or the place identity.

boundary.description: For Chinese-language toponyms, use Sino-Korean reading before this date and contemporary Chinese pronunciation from this date onward. The date is the agreed map-label style threshold, not an assertion of wholesale city renamings.

rules.koreanLabelConvention: Korean transcription of Japanese place-name pronunciation
rules.exclude: Sino-Korean readings of Japanese place-name kanji as separate aliases (e.g. 동경 for 東京, 대판 for 大阪).
rules.historicalLocalToponyms: Respect actual historical name changes (e.g. 江戸 -> 에도, 東京 -> 도쿄).

rules.koreanLabelConvention: Sino-Korean reading of selected Chinese-language local toponym
Korean transcription of Chinese pronunciation of selected Chinese-language local toponym

resolutionOrder: Choose a date-appropriate local toponym from names[] using documented official naming periods when available; year-only dates remain approximate.
Apply a map-label language convention to THAT toponym, not to its present-day English name.
Use a verified koMapLabels mapping if the name is covered; otherwise hold for review rather than guessing a transliteration.
Do not derive naming language, polity or sovereignty from sourceCountryCode; this is GeoNames source metadata only.
exceptions: For Chinese minority-language, non-Mandarin and multilingual places choose the applicable local toponym/language explicitly; do not apply Mandarin reading solely because sourceCountryCode is CN.
note: This file defines a staging convention for current and future city batches; it does not change the deployed runtime, map labels, or the existing historical name periods.
